## Introduction

Hello! I'm Youngjun Park, an urban researcher and architect.

Based on my knowledge in architecture and urban design, I explore rational and evidence-based urban research and design using data science techniques.

Currently, I work as a partner architect at AR-GE Architects, participating in research and development of architectural/urban design solutions using Agentic AI.

## Education

### Doctoral Degree
- **Ph.D. in Architecture**, Seoul National University (2022)
  - Dissertation: Urban Pedestrian Pattern Analysis Using Smartphone GPS Data

### Master's Degree
- **M.S. in Urban Design**, Seoul National University (2017)
  - Thesis: Analysis of Correlation between Urban Spatial Structure and Human Behavior

### Bachelor's Degree
- **B.S. in Architecture**, Seoul National University (2013)

## Projects

### Major Research Projects

- **Urban Pedestrian Pattern Prediction System** (2022-2024)

- **AI-based Real Estate Valuation Model** (2023-2024)
  - Development of accommodation demand prediction model using Airbnb data
  - Achieved 85% accuracy

- **Smart City Integrated Platform** (2021-2023)

  - Applied to Daejeon Metropolitan City Smart City Project
